content: Root cause: The bug in the ExistingMacIT test was caused by the test not waiting long enough for ephemeral nodes in Zookeeper to be removed before proceeding. The original sleep duration of 10 seconds was insufficient, leading to potential race conditions where the test would fail if the ephemeral nodes were still present. The fix adjusts the wait time to match the configured Zookeeper timeout, ensuring that the test reliably waits for the necessary conditions to be met.
